verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own docs list "Board Resolutions & Voting" as a plan feature and describe "integrated board management tools," plus built-in e-signing and centralized document management. These are first-party but thin claims, and the evidence never shows how consents are drafted, routed, or linked to transactions. Missing for 10: documented drafting/templating of board consents, stockholder approval workflows, e-signature routing specifically for resolutions, archiving consents against the issuances or transactions they authorize, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
